description.value: Lai Leung (梨良記牛雜蛇羹專家) is a traditional Cantonese fast-food counter on Richmond's Number 3 Road specializing in beef offal and snake soup — dishes rarely found outside Hong Kong-style delis. For a touring cyclist riding the Richmond dyke trails or Olympic Oval loop, it represents an authentic and unusual culinary detour into one of Canada's most distinctive Chinese food corridors.
